Luminary

luminaries, which means she can be in possession of more
beacons than her peers. And, she has creative ways to use
those beacons against her enemies. She stays on the move,
traveling from location to location and searching for
beacons to ensure she always has some at the ready (her
power stalls when she finds herself without any). Courage
has also learned how to use the experience she gains on her
quests to pull oǤ exciting feats of combat and exploration.
In addition to all of this, Courage thrives under adversity.
When faced with a multitude of enemies, she can unleash
devastating abilities that can turn the tide of the battle.
Sometimes her courage can get her in over her head. But
her virtue compels her to finish what she started.

text_lines.text: Complexity 5/10
Justice
Luminary
Justice is the hardiest and most gifted in combat of the
new generation of Luminaries. His zeal for lawfulness and
truth motivates him, even when he is taking on wounds
in the process. Scratch that; especially when taking on
wounds. He believes pain brings focus and clarity. He can
unleash surprising and devastating attacks when by all
rights he should be shrinking back from the threat. He's
effective in battle, but he's not just a blunt instrument.
He's surgical with his attacks. He's done his homework.
He knows his enemies and their precise weaknesses. And,
he learns more about his opponents as he fights them.
His biggest shortcoming is a low capacity for carrying
beacons. This makes travel less reliable and healing harder
to come by. Healng was always the backup plan anyway.

Luminary
Temperance is at his best when he focuses on moderation.
In fact, he wields it like a sword and shield. The experience
he gains on his quests can be stored up to fuel powerful
skills that allow him to stay in control of any situation. That
control is what makes Temperance so unique among the
Luminaries. He does not embrace the chaotic strategies
that Justice and Courage use so effectively. Temperance
prefers to avoid getting into those tight spots in the first
place. He does not enjoy defeating enemies or venturing
into dark landscapes, but his sense of duty compels him to
it. And his extreme discipline makes him one of the most
effective Luminaries of the new generation. Yet, he is not
without failings. Old temptations regularly test his will.
On these days, he works even harder.

Wisdom
Luminary
Wisdom is the first elder in history to be appointed a
Luminary. In his youth he was once both a hunter and
a scorchwright, but his eyesight failed him decades ago
and his body is weak with age. He makes up for these
shortcomings in other ways. He masterfully commands
the elements, ensuring his best combination of skills
never goes to waste. And he can conserve light resources
when focusing on exploration. But his most impressive
feature is his ability to put trances on his enemies. He
trained for years to perfect this craft. Trances allow him to
manipulate enemies. He fights opportunistically, applying
and removing trances to masterfully control the tempo
of his battles. At his age and with all his achievements,
Wisdom has nothing to prove to anyone. And his enemies
can smell it on him.

text_lines.text: Complexity 7/10
Scorchwright
Profession
We have of course repurposed the profession since the new
threats emerged, but historically scorchwrights had an
important (but peaceful) purpose in Farhome society. Fire
needs photonic energy to be ignited and sustained. The
larger the fire needed, the greater the skill required. Larger
and more complex fires, such as lighting the watchtowers
or sustaining wayfaring torches, require assistance from a
scorchwright. Some found the prospect too brutal, but most
understood the reality that, when the new threats emerged,
fire would be one of our most effective weapons against
the enemy. If a scorchwright can keep the fires burning hot
enough, they can control the battlefield through fear and
pain. If the light runs low, however, there may be a swift
reckoning from a vengeful evil.

name: Complexity 5/10

text_lines.text: Complexity 5/10
Wayfarer
Profession
Few venture outside the city, but when there is need,
wayfarers are the ones who make it possible. They are
experts in finding secret paths and tunnels. Everyone from
hunters seeking game to wardens checking on outpost
communities rely on wayfarers to get them where they
are going safely. They spend countless hours training their
skills of navigation. They become experts in the topography
surrounding Farhome. And, when in unfamiliar territory,
they can learn quickly. They lean on their knowledge of
various types of landscapes to inform their strategies for
finding their destination. The darkness is disheartening
and disorienting. In these moments, a wayfaring Luminary
is perhaps the most welcome sight one could hope to see.
